Try Shrunked Image Resizer (https://github.com/memeller/shrunked).

- In the right column, click the 'Latest' button

- scroll down and click right-click 'shrunked_image_resizer-5.10.3.xpi' > click 'Save link as' and save it somewhere

- open TB menu > Add-ons and Themes

- click the gear to the right > Install Add-on From File

- navigate to where you saved the .xpi file > double-click it
